scientific_semantics.weighting: Token values are averaged within each rollout, then rollouts equally within context, then contexts equally. Secondary uniform-token weighting uses original positive lengths and summed token values. Producer means/sums/min/max are checked for finite nonnegative consistent values and sparse-count bounds.
scientific_semantics.energy: Residual-energy fraction is the ratio of two equally context/rollout-weighted mean energies, not a mean of token-specific or context-specific ratios. These are saved FP32 sparse-algorithm diagnostics. The report and documentation separate them from centered pooled target variance.
scientific_semantics.null: Exactly-affine null decomposition statistics use one stored vector per context and algebraically repeat it over each original positive token length and the same registered rollout seeds. Actual null prepared_sources hashes bind the layout and decomposition arrays. Ragged explicit-token repetition agrees with this reduction.
scientific_semantics.geometry: Population-centered variance traces and twice component/remainder covariance use the pooled original targets on the same common contexts; reconstruction is verified. Component and remainder variances are not presented as additive without covariance.
scientific_semantics.predictions: The existing read_arrays verifies saved target/input fingerprints and recorded metrics before common-cohort alignment. The new report recomputes own-target SSE/SST/R2 and bias statistics for already-fitted ridge and MLP predictions. No fitting, tuning, selection, matching or new uncertainty estimand is introduced; paired R2 intervals remain in the main comparator.
scientific_semantics.undefined: Zero token input energy and zero pooled full variance remain flagged with undefined fractions. Constant-target R2 stays undefined. Sparse maximum L0 and increased-error contexts are preserved in JSON and CSV.

source_and_failure_checks.observed: All 24 observed statistics sources required exactly once; native unrotated k10 consumes diagnostics, other cells statistics. Real Source byte verification, analyzer implementation/identity/input-proof binding, exact all-split fitted component hash ledgers, successful marker-bound analyzer terminal and exact test row order are checked.
source_and_failure_checks.grid: Exactly 48 registered role/kind/k/rotation cells, no duplicate or missing cells, completed comparison marker and coverage, frozen config/selection, immutable matching cell proofs and all three scope reports on the same common cohort are required.
source_and_failure_checks.partial_failure: Fresh outputs only. Fit-source/preflight failures leave no output root. A later statistics failure preserves already completed cells without a final completion marker. A fresh retry must use a separate root; this consumer does not claim automatic resume.
source_and_failure_checks.artifacts: Report and CSV hashes, input-manifest hash, both runtime identities and script/module hashes are saved; final marker binds every cell marker and thus both per-cell JSON and NPZ sidecars.
